svg.title: Knowledge used in the theory-lineage cards
svg.desc: Partial classification of 2,058 papers: 6,264 of 51,815 source records classified (12.1%). Three knowledge types branch into concepts and methods, counting coded source uses rather than papers.

text.tspan: Knowledge used in the theory-lineage cards
Clustering, mining and statistical learning methods
Affective computing: automatic recognition of emotion
Differential privacy and privacy-preserving data release
Computer graphics and physical simulation techniques
One source cited by two papers contributes two uses.
